sn9.9:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam aññataro Vajjiputtako bhikkhu Vesaliyaṃ viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || Tena kho pana samayena Vesāliyaṃ sabbaratti-cāro hoti || || Atha kho so bhikkhu Vesāliyaṃ turiya-tāḷita-vāditanighosa-saddaṃ sutvā paridevamāno tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn9.9:2.1: Ekakā mayam araññe viharāma || apaviddhaṃ va vanasmiṃ dārukaṃ || etadisikāya rattiyā || ko sunāma amhehi pāpiyo ti || ||
sn9.9:3.1: Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetukāmā yena so bhikkhu ten-upasaṅkami || || Upasaṅkamitvā tam bhikkhuṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.9:4.1: Ekako tvaṃ araññe viharasi || apaviddhaṃ va vanasmiṃ dārukaṃ || tassa te bahukā pihayanti || nerayikā viya saggagaminan ti || ||
sn9.9:5.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu tāya devatāya saṃvejito {saṃvegam} apādīti || ||
